name: Charge 15
definition: Amount of money associated with a service.

Type.name: Type
Type.definition: Type of service for which a charge is asked or paid.

ExtendedType.name: Extended Type
ExtendedType.definition: Type of service for which a charge is asked or paid.

Amount.name: Amount
Amount.definition: Amount of money asked or paid for the charge.

Rate.name: Rate
Rate.definition: Rate used to calculate the amount of the charge or fee.

CalculationBasis.name: Calculation Basis
CalculationBasis.definition: Calculation basis for the charge or fee.

ExtendedCalculationBasis.name: Extended Calculation Basis
ExtendedCalculationBasis.definition: Calculation basis for the charge or fee.

TypeOrExtendedTypeRule.definition: Either Type or ExtendedType must be present, but not both.

AmountOrRateRule.definition: Either Amount or Rate must be present, but not both.

CalculationBasisOrExtendedCalculationBas.definition: Either CalculationBasis or ExtendedCalculationBasis may be present, but not both.
